verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a built-in dashboard for usage, cost and performance across providers, and an HQL query language in paid tiers. Its GitHub README offers a one-line PostHog export 'for custom dashboards', so custom dashboard building relies on an external tool rather than a documented native dashboard builder. missing for 10: native custom dashboard builder, explicit latency/error/eval-score metric widgets, eval scores surfaced in dashboards, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: Track usage, costs, and performance across all providers in one dashboard
